versions.content: Mix of static definition consisting of multicast subscrip- tion clients and unicast subscription clients at the server It is well supported to define both, a set of ProvidedServiceInstance . remoteUnicastAddress and a set of ProvidedServiceInstance . remoteMulticastSubscriptionAddress references. The server is then configured to handle the union of both sets as the predefined clients.
